Turtle Dive Homestay

A homestay on Pulau Kri, built by hand from local timber and standing at the edge of a reef we leave the way we found it. Kept by the family who has always lived in this bay, at the pace the tide sets.

Know us better

One jetty, one family,
and the reef right in front of it

01 · Why here

Hospitality that feels like family.

Guests are looked after by the family who built this homestay and still live here. The rooms are traditional Papuan work in timber and thatch, simple by design, and a Starlink connection reaches almost every one of them, fast enough for a video call. Every deck opens onto the same view: the Dampier Strait, the karst islands beyond it, and the reef directly below.

Turtle Dive Center

Dive in the morning, back before lunch

Training partner

We dive the Dampier Strait: Cape Kri, Mike's Point, Sardine Reef, Manta Point, all of them 20 to 45 minutes by boat from the jetty. The boat goes out twice a day, six divers per guide at most.

When to come

The sea has its seasons

Raja Ampat can be visited all year, but the water is not the same every month. This is what we see from our own jetty.

Best season
October – February

The calmest water and the longest visibility. Mantas show up most often between December and February. Rooms fill early, so book well ahead.

Still good
March – April, August – September

Mixed weather, but diving runs almost every day. Quieter, and the jetty is yours more often.

Quiet season
May – July

The southeast wind is up, the swell is bigger, and the further sites are sometimes called off. The emptiest months, and the right ones if you want the island to yourself.

Getting here

Four steps from Jakarta

A long trip, but a straight one. Tell us your boat time and ours will be waiting at Waisai.

  1. 01
    Fly to Sorong

    Domine Eduard Osok airport (SOQ). Daily flights from Jakarta, Makassar and Manado.

  2. 02
    Ferry to Waisai

    Fast ferry from Sorong harbour, about 2 hours. Two departures a day, morning and midday.

  3. 03
    Pay the park fee

    The Raja Ampat environmental services card is arranged in Waisai. Valid for one year.

  4. 04
    We collect you

    Our boat meets you at Waisai harbour, about an hour to Pulau Kri. Send us your ferry time on WhatsApp.

Asked often

You have to know!

Is there electricity and internet?+

There is power in the evening only — the hours are with the rates above, and that is when everything gets charged. Alongside the phone signal there is Starlink, fast enough for a video call, and it reaches almost every bungalow. If a reliable connection matters to your stay, say so when you book and we will put you in one of the bungalows where the signal is strongest.

What about food?+

Three meals a day are included: breakfast, lunch and dinner, at the times listed with the rates above, and the kitchen does not serve outside them. Local food, cooked the way the family cooks it. Tell us before you arrive if you are vegetarian, have a restricted diet, or any allergy.

Do I need to swim well to snorkel?+

You do not need to be strong in the water. We provide floats and a guide is always in the water with you.

Can I pay by card?+

There is no card machine on the island. If the booking button took you to a payment page, that page takes cards, bank transfer and the usual e-wallets; otherwise pay by transfer before you arrive or in cash at check-in — and bring enough cash from Sorong or Waisai either way.

Are children welcome?+

Yes. A bungalow sleeps two, and a third person sleeps on an extra bed — one per bungalow, priced by age, and the figures are with the rates above. Tell us the ages when you write. The snorkelling trip is safe for children who are comfortable in the water.
